data.one_liner: Display single or multiple images in a full-screen dialog with pinch and zoom support.
data.what_it_does: Provides an easy way to display images in a full-screen dialog with pinch and zoom capabilities. Supports single images as well as swipeable lists of images with features like double-tap to zoom, swipe-down to dismiss, and infinite scrolling.
use_when: You need to show a full-screen image viewer with pinch and zoom.
You want to display a swipeable gallery or slideshow of multiple images.
You need a quick solution to view local or network images without custom UI boilerplate.
avoid_when: You are building a custom inline image view rather than a full-screen dialog.
You require complex image editing or cropping tools.
strengths: Supports both single images and swipeable multi-image lists out of the box.
Includes built-in pinch & zoom, double-tap to zoom, and swipe-down to dismiss.
weaknesses: Focused primarily on full-screen dialog presentation rather than inline UI components.
Limited to image viewing features (no editing, cropping, etc.).

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you need highly customizable zoomable image widgets that can be embedded directly inline within widget trees instead of just full-screen dialogs.
